_comment: Qoder usage reply, GET openapi.qoder.sh/api/v2/quota/usage (task 035). The live wire, measured 2026-11-18: a FLAT camelCase object, no envelope; totalUsagePercentage and the package percentage fields are FRACTIONS 0..1, expiresAt is epoch MILLISECONDS. One row per package since 2026-11-18 (the owner's correction): userQuota -> 'month (plan)', addOnQuota -> 'month (add-on)'; the summed totalUsagePercentage (332 of 20400) is only the fallback for a reply without packages. dedicatedResourcePackages is absent -- not read. Synthetic values; no personal data. Only read by the reference tool in --offline mode when a Qoder login is present.
